to: Any developer creates an app and bot token free in the Developer Portal. App Verification (the owner's identity check through Stripe plus a checklist) is required for an app to scale past 100 servers (https://support-dev.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/23926564536471-How-Do-I-Get-My-App-Verified). Privileged intents (MESSAGE_CONTENT, GUILD_MEMBERS, GUILD_PRESENCES) can be self-enabled until the app reaches 10,000 unique users; above that Discord reviews access (and again every year), and new installs are not blocked while review is pending (https://support-dev.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/40281523410967-Changes-to-Privileged-Intent-Access-for-Discord-Apps).
